description: S9 read-only process audit with PASS/FAIL/UNVERIFIABLE per control.

cases.prompt: Audit whether the change in PR 42 followed the Orcasus gates.

assertions: Fixes the baseline to the VERSION and CLAUDE.md in force at the change's commit.
Uses git history, CI runs, records and approvals as evidence; treats the closeout as a claim.
Gives each applicable control PASS, FAIL or UNVERIFIABLE with an evidence path; missing evidence never passes.
Classifies each FAIL as a policy or discipline gap and names the closing control.
Changes no files and lists what was not inspected.

cases.prompt: The agent merged its own PR after CI went green. Was that allowed?

assertions: Checks for a recorded owner grant covering the merge; without one, merge authority is FAIL.

cases.prompt: Audit slice SL-1; the meeting event files were deleted.

assertions: Marks the decision-record control UNVERIFIABLE, not PASS, and gives an overall CONDITIONAL verdict at best.

cases.prompt: I just finished the task. Write up what I did.

assertions: Routes to closeout-report; an audit is independent and retrospective.
Routes to delivery-readiness, not a retrospective audit.
